title: Principals: who may act in the governance log (product rule 2026-10-24, DECISIONS D22)
description: governance/principals.json. Five roles, each with its own id prefix: pessoa (kind humano: decides product rules, approves with a reason, adjudicates); leitor (kind automatizado: proposes readings of the law by choosing passage ids; familia A or B; motor = technical engine id and version); extrator (automatizado: proposes facts from documents with position); redator (automatizado: explains what is already decided, under the citation guard; records nothing in the log); ferramenta (kind codigo: a versioned tool with the hash of its code, e.g. ferramenta:verify@1). Capabilities per role are in engine/governance.py CAPABILITIES. A retired principal records nothing new; its past events stay valid.

code.description: ferramenta: path of the tool's code inside the repository; verify checks its sha256 equals hash while the principal is not retired (PROV).

retired_at.description: When the principal was retired (D41): its events at or before this instant stay valid; none after it.
